name: Safari collage
oneLiner: a maximal torn-paper collage of real CC0 photos: torn strips with white rims, a real 3D boombox printed silver with the brand mark in its deck, a dive into the speaker, a 12-wedge kaleidoscope, a Muybridge eagle flapping, hills panning at four speeds, a title on a torn newspaper peak
bestFor: loud, joyful launches; audio, media, creator and consumer AI brands; anything that wants to feel like a music video or a zine; widescreen intros and ads
motion: pieces slide in from their own sides (power3.out) and pop (back.out), every cut-out boils on twos, a power3.in dive through the object's speaker, a turning kaleidoscope, a 12 fps frame-cycle eagle, linear parallax, a steps(3) title slam

sound.ui: whoosh on slide-ins, the dive, the eagle and the hills, pop on the object, the mark and every animal, shimmer as the kaleidoscope opens and on the URL, one hit on the title
